#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

<?php

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Route Permission Mappings
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Map named routes to required permissions. The RouteCapabilityMiddleware
    | is appended globally to the web middleware group (bootstrap/app.php),
    | so EVERY named web route must have an entry here.
    |
    | Value types:
    |   '__public__'             → no auth required (open to all visitors)
    |   null                     → auth required, no capability check
    |   'capability.scope'       → single capability check via Gate
    |   'cap1 | cap2'            → any of (OR)
    |   'cap1 & cap2'            → all of (AND)
    |   'system_admin_access'    → special check (shouldBypassTeamScope)
    |
    */

    'routes' => [

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventExportType;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PlanGateFailed;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventExportService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class EventExportController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(
        Event $event,
        string $type,
        EventService $events,
        EventExportService $exports,
    ): StreamedResponse|Response {
        $exportType = EventExportType::tryFrom($type);
        abort_if(! $exportType instanceof EventExportType, 404);

        $actor = authUser();
        abort_if(! $actor instanceof User, 403);
        $events->authorizeViewAccess($event, $actor);

        try {
            return $exports->response($event, $actor, $exportType);
        } catch (PlanGateFailed $e) {
            return response(__('events.exports.errors.plan_gate'), $e->httpStatus());
        }
    }
}

namespace Platform\Authz\Core;

use Closure;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Contracts\PermissionSubjectInterface;
use Platform\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantContextInterface;

/**
 * Two-tier permission caching: request-scoped + persistent Laravel cache.
 *
 * Uses PermissionSubjectInterface instead of App\Models\User for portability.
 * Uses TenantContextInterface (from platform-tenancy) for tenant-aware cache keys.
 */
class PermissionCacheService
{
    public const CACHE_DURATION = 3600;

    /**
     * Maximum number of tracked cache keys per user.
     * When exceeded, oldest keys are evicted first.
     */
    private const MAX_TRACKED_KEYS = 500;

    private int $cacheDuration;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->cacheDuration = (int) config('platform-authz.cache_ttl', self::CACHE_DURATION);
    }

    public function rememberRouteAccess(string $routeName, PermissionSubjectInterface $user, Closure $compute): bool
    {
        return $this->rememberBooleanCheck('route_access', $routeName, $user, $compute);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string>
     */
    public function rememberAccessibleRoutes(PermissionSubjectInterface $user, Closure $compute): array
    {
        $userId = $user->getAuthIdentifier();
        $requestKey = RequestCacheService::keyForUser($userId, 'accessible_routes', [$this->currentTenantId() ?? 'global']);

        return RequestCacheService::remember($requestKey, function () use ($user, $compute) {
            $persistentKey = $this->accessibleRoutesKey($user);
            $value = cache()->remember($persistentKey, $this->cacheDuration, function () use ($compute) {
                return (array) $compute();
            });

            $this->trackUserCacheKey($user, $persistentKey);

            return $value;
        });
    }

    public function rememberPermissionCheck(PermissionSubjectInterface $user, string $permissions, Closure $compute): bool
    {
        return $this->rememberBooleanCheck('permission_check', $permissions, $user, $compute);

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventType;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<Event>
 */
class EventFactory extends Factory
{
    protected $model = Event::class;

    public function definition(): array
    {
        $startsAt = $this->faker->dateTimeBetween('+1 day', '+60 days');
        $endsAt = (clone $startsAt)->modify('+1 hour');

        return [
            'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'team_id' => Team::factory(),
            'state' => EventState::DRAFT->value,
            'title' => $this->faker->sentence(4),
            'description' => $this->faker->paragraph(),
            // Produces a string; Eloquent's EventType cast hydrates it to an enum
            // instance on the model (both make() and create() go through the cast).
            'type' => $this->faker->randomElement(EventType::cases())->value,
            'starts_at' => $startsAt,
            'ends_at' => $endsAt,
            'timezone' => 'UTC',
            'created_by' => User::factory(),
        ];
    }

    public function withLanding(string $template = 'classic'): self
    {
        return $this->afterCreating(function (Event $event) use ($template) {
            if (!$event->landingPage()->exists()) {
                \App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage::forceCreate([
                    'event_id' => $event->id,
                    'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                    'template' => $template,
                    'primary_color' => '#8B2323',
                ]);
            }
        });
    }

    public function inState(EventState $state): self
    {
        return $this->state(fn () => ['state' => $state->value]);
    }

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Traits\PermissionTesting;
use Tests\Traits\TeamTesting;

/**
 * Base class for feature tests
 * 
 * Feature tests validate HTTP requests, routes, and full application workflows.
 * They test the application from the outside-in, simulating real user interactions.
 */
abstract class FeatureTestCase extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;
    use PermissionTesting;
    use TeamTesting;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // RefreshDatabase wipes the permissions table every test, so we reseed
        // when it's empty. The old `$permissionsSeeded` static was dead code
        // (set but never read) and misleadingly suggested per-class caching
        // that couldn't work under RefreshDatabase. Removed 2026-04-23 per
        // test-review-1-3 isolation finding.
        $this->seedPermissionsOnce();
    }
    
    /**
     * Seed permissions only once per test run to avoid redundant seeding
     */
    protected function seedPermissionsOnce(): void
    {
        // Check if permissions table is empty (RefreshDatabase clears it)
        if (\App\Models\RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shortcut: create an email-verified user. Targets the 25+ repetitions
     * of `User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()])` across
     * Epic 1 suites (test-review-1-3 Maintainability finding).
     */
    protected function verifiedUser(array $attributes = []): \App\Models\User
    {
        return \App\Models\User::factory()->create(array_merge(
            ['email_verified_at' => now()],
            $attributes,
        ));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\Authz\Http;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class RouteCapabilityMiddleware
{
    private const REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE = 'platform_authz.route_capability_evaluated';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly RouteRequirementResolver $resolver,
    ) {}

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        if ($request->attributes->get(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE) === true) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $request->attributes->set(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE, true);

        $routeName = $request->route()?->getName();

        if (!$routeName) {
            abort(403, 'Route must be named for permission checks.');
        }

        $requirement = $this->resolver->resolve($routeName);

        // A protected named route without an explicit route-permission mapping is a
        // configuration error. Fail closed rather than silently widening access.
        if ($requirement === null) {
            abort(403, 'Route permission mapping is missing for this route.');
        }

        // Public routes bypass all auth/capability checks — the route is
        // open to all visitors, authenticated or not.
        if ($requirement->type === RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $user = $request->user();

        if (!$user) {
            abort(403, 'Authentication required.');
        }

        if (!$this->evaluate($requirement, $user)) {
            abort(403, 'You do not have permission to access this route.');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }

    public function evaluate(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return match ($requirement->type) {
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE => $this->evaluateSingle($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF => $this->evaluateAnyOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF => $this->evaluateAllOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL => $this->evaluateSpecial($requirement, $user),
            default => false,
        };
    }

    private function evaluateSingle(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($user)->allows($requirement->capabilities[0]);
    }

    private function evaluateAnyOf(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\RolePermission;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\RegistrationSource;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route as RouteFacade;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\TestDox;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support\InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

/**
 * Capsule T4 — platform-admin export of a single event's registration list.
 *
 * Registration rows carry attendee personal data, so the endpoint must be gated
 * on the explicit global event-visibility capability rather than on generic
 * admin-area access.
 */
class AdminEventRegistrationExportTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    private const ROUTE = 'admin.events.registrations.export';

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 / AC4 / AC5 — CSV download scoped to the requested event
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-01 [P0] Given a platform admin when they export an event then a CSV download contains only that event\'s registrations')]
    public function platform_admin_exports_only_the_requested_events_registrations(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $admin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $target = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Delivery Complaint Webinar');
        $other = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Unrelated Webinar');

        $this->registration($target, 'target@example.test', 'Target Registrant');
        $this->registration($other, 'other@example.test', 'Other Registrant');

        $route = RouteFacade::getRoutes()->getByName(self::ROUTE);
        $this->assertNotNull($route, 'The registration export route must be registered.');
        $this->assertContains('GET', $route->methods(), 'The registration export must be a GET route.');
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('admin/', $route->uri(), 'The export must live under the platform-admin routes.');

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route(self::ROUTE, $target->uuid));

        $response->assertOk();
        $this->assertStringContainsString(
            'text/csv',
            (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Type'),
            'The export must be delivered as CSV.',
        );

        $disposition = (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Disposition');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('attachment', $disposition, 'The export must be delivered as a download.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('.csv', $disposition);
        $this->assertTrue(
            str_contains($disposition, $target->uuid)
                || str_contains(strtolower($disposition), 'delivery-complaint-webinar'),
            "The download filename must identify the exported event. Got: {$disposition}",
        );

        $csv = $this->streamedContent($response);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Target Registrant', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('target@example.test', $csv);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Other Registrant', $csv, 'Another event\'s registrations must not leak.');
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('other@example.test', $csv, 'Another event\'s registrations must not leak.');
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — admin-area access alone does not unlock the export
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-02 [P0] Given an admin-area user without global event visibility when they request the export then they are refused and receive no CSV')]
    public function admin_area_user_without_global_event_visibility_is_refused(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $admin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Delivery Complaint Webinar');
        $this->registration($event, 'target@example.test', 'Target Registrant');

        $this->revokeGlobalEventVisibility();

        // The actor still reaches the admin area — only the event-visibility
        // capability is missing.
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('admin.dashboard'))->assertOk();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route(self::ROUTE, $event->uuid));

        $response->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            'text/csv',
            (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Type'),
            'A refused request must not return a CSV payload.',
        );

        $body = (string) $response->getContent();
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Target Registrant', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('target@example.test', $body);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC2 / AC6 — capability mapping is explicit and pre-existing routes are untouched
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-03 [P0] Given the route-permission config when the export route is added then it maps to global event visibility and no other admin route changes')]
    public function export_route_is_capability_gated_without_widening_existing_admin_routes(): void
    {
        /** @var array<string, string|null> $routes */
        $routes = config('route_permissions.routes');

        $this->assertSame(
            'events.view.global',
            $routes[self::ROUTE] ?? null,
            'The export must be gated on the global capability governing platform-wide event visibility.',
        );

        foreach ($this->preExistingAdminRoutePermissions() as $name => $capability) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey($name, $routes, "Pre-existing admin route {$name} lost its permission entry.");
            $this->assertSame($capability, $routes[$name], "Pre-existing admin route {$name} changed its permission entry.");
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function eventFor(Team $team, string $title): Event
    {
        /** @var Event $event */
        $event = Event::factory()->create([
            'team_id' => $team->id,
            'created_by' => $team->user_id,
            'state' => EventState::ENDED->value,
            'title' => $title,
            'starts_at' => now()->subHours(3),
            'ends_at' => now()->subHours(2),
        ]);

        return $event;
    }

    private function registration(Event $event, string $email, string $name): Registration
    {
        return Registration::forceCreate([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', strtolower($email)),
            'full_name' => $name,
            'company' => 'Support Co',
            'country' => 'TR',
            'source' => RegistrationSource::DIRECT->value,
            'consent_accepted_at' => now()->subHours(2),
            'preferred_locale' => 'en',
        ]);
    }

    private function revokeGlobalEventVisibility(): void
    {
        $role = Role::where('key', UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value)->firstOrFail();

        RolePermission::where('role_id', $role->id)
            ->where('resource', 'events')
            ->where('action', 'view')
            ->forceDelete();
    }

    private function streamedContent(mixed $response): string
    {
        ob_start();
        $response->baseResponse->sendContent();

        return (string) ob_get_clean();
    }

    /**
     * Permission entries that existed before this capsule. None may change.
     *
     * @return array<string, string|null>
     */
    private function preExistingAdminRoutePermissions(): array
    {
        return [
            'admin.dashboard' => 'system_admin_access',
            'admin.events.index' => 'events.view.global',
            'admin.operations.kill-switches' => 'system_admin_access',
            'admin.privacy.erasure' => 'system_admin_access',
            'admin.events.show' => 'events.view.global',
            'admin.events.edit' => 'events.update.global',
            'admin.events.update' => 'events.update.global',
            'admin.events.landing.edit' => 'events.update.global',
            'admin.events.landing.preview' => 'events.update.global',
            'admin.events.form-config.edit' => 'events.update.global',
            'admin.events.automations.show' => 'automations.manage.global',
            'admin.events.automations.detail' => 'automations.manage.global',
            'admin.events.automations.toggle' => 'automations.manage.global',
            'admin.events.automations.update' => 'automations.manage.global',
            'admin.events.prepare' => 'events.update.global',
            'admin.events.publish' => 'events.publish.global',
            'admin.events.cancel' => 'events.cancel.global',
            'admin.events.suspend' => 'events.suspend.global',
            'admin.events.reactivate' => 'events.suspend.global',
            'admin.events.force-end' => 'events.force_end.global',
            'admin.events.lock-publishing' => 'events.suspend.global',
            'admin.events.unlock-publishing' => 'events.suspend.global',
            'admin.events.lock-go-live' => 'events.force_end.global',
            'admin.events.unlock-go-live' => 'events.force_end.global',

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Role;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route as RouteFacade;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\TestDox;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support\InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

/**
 * Capsule T4 — platform-admin export of a single event's registration list.
 *
 * Registration rows carry attendee personal data, so the endpoint must be gated
 * on the explicit global event-visibility capability rather than on generic
 * admin-area access.
 */
class AdminEventRegistrationExportTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    private const ROUTE = 'admin.events.registrations.export';

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 / AC4 / AC5 — CSV download scoped to the requested event
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-01 [P0] Given a platform admin when they export an event then a CSV download contains only that event\'s registrations')]
    public function platform_admin_exports_only_the_requested_events_registrations(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $admin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $target = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Delivery Complaint Webinar');
        $other = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Unrelated Webinar');

        $this->registration($target, 'target@example.test', 'Target Registrant');
        $this->registration($other, 'other@example.test', 'Other Registrant');

        $route = RouteFacade::getRoutes()->getByName(self::ROUTE);
        $this->assertNotNull($route, 'The registration export route must be registered.');
        $this->assertContains('GET', $route->methods(), 'The registration export must be a GET route.');
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('admin/', $route->uri(), 'The export must live under the platform-admin routes.');

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route(self::ROUTE, $target->uuid));

        $response->assertOk();
        $this->assertStringContainsString(
            'text/csv',
            (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Type'),
            'The export must be delivered as CSV.',
        );

        $disposition = (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Disposition');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('attachment', $disposition, 'The export must be delivered as a download.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('.csv', $disposition);
        $this->assertTrue(
            str_contains($disposition, $target->uuid)
                || str_contains(strtolower($disposition), 'delivery-complaint-webinar'),
            "The download filename must identify the exported event. Got: {$disposition}",
        );

        $csv = $this->streamedContent($response);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Target Registrant', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('target@example.test', $csv);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Other Registrant', $csv, 'Another event\'s registrations must not leak.');
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('other@example.test', $csv, 'Another event\'s registrations must not leak.');
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — admin-area access alone does not unlock the export
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-02 [P0] Given an admin-area user without global event visibility when they request the export then they are refused and receive no CSV')]
    public function admin_area_user_without_global_event_visibility_is_refused(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $admin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Delivery Complaint Webinar');
        $this->registration($event, 'target@example.test', 'Target Registrant');

        $this->revokeGlobalEventVisibility();

        // The actor still reaches the admin area — only the event-visibility
        // capability is missing.
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('admin.dashboard'))->assertOk();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route(self::ROUTE, $event->uuid));

        $response->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            'text/csv',
            (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Type'),
            'A refused request must not return a CSV payload.',
        );

        $body = (string) $response->getContent();
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Target Registrant', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('target@example.test', $body);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC2 / AC6 — capability mapping is explicit and pre-existing routes are untouched
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-03 [P0] Given the route-permission config when the export route is added then it maps to global event visibility and no other admin route changes')]
    public function export_route_is_capability_gated_without_widening_existing_admin_routes(): void
    {
        /** @var array<string, string|null> $routes */
        $routes = config('route_permissions.routes');

        $this->assertSame(
            'events.view.global',
            $routes[self::ROUTE] ?? null,
            'The export must be gated on the global capability governing platform-wide event visibility.',
        );

        foreach ($this->preExistingAdminRoutePermissions() as $name => $capability) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey($name, $routes, "Pre-existing admin route {$name} lost its permission entry.");
            $this->assertSame($capability, $routes[$name], "Pre-existing admin route {$name} changed its permission entry.");
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function eventFor(Team $team, string $title): Event
    {
        /** @var Event $event */
        $event = Event::factory()->create([
            'team_id' => $team->id,
            'created_by' => $team->user_id,
            'state' => EventState::ENDED->value,
            'title' => $title,
            'starts_at' => now()->subHours(3),
            'ends_at' => now()->subHours(2),
        ]);

        return $event;
    }

    private function registration(Event $event, string $email, string $name): Registration
    {
        return Registration::forceCreate([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,

class RoleActionController
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly SuperAdminRoleService $service,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Show the permission-matrix editor for a role.
     *
     * SYSTEM_ADMIN is rendered read-only (no form).
     * Non-system roles render an editable permission-matrix form.
     */
    public function show(string $roleUuid): View
    {
        $role = $this->service->findByUuidOrFail($roleUuid);

        // Eager-load the permission count so the view uses $role->permissions_count
        // (avoiding an N+1 per-render query).
        $role->loadCount('permissions');

        // Group available permissions by resource for the matrix view.
        // AC2 scope filter: SYSTEM_ADMIN (is_system_admin=true) sees global-only permissions;
        // all other roles see non-global (team-scoped) permissions only.
        // Keyed on is_system_admin per Dev Notes flag-precision rule.
        $allPermissions = PermissionRegistry::allWithSystem();
        $permissionsByResource = [];
        foreach ($allPermissions as $permission) {
            $isGlobal = PermissionRegistry::isGlobalPermission($permission);
            // Skip permissions whose scope does not match this role type.
            if ($role->is_system_admin && ! $isGlobal) {
                continue;
            }
            if (! $role->is_system_admin && $isGlobal) {
                continue;
            }
            [$resource] = PermissionRegistry::parsePermission($permission);
            if ($resource !== null) {
                $permissionsByResource[$resource][] = $permission;
            }
        }
        ksort($permissionsByResource);

        return view('super-admin::roles.show', compact('role', 'permissionsByResource'));

class SuperAdminEventService
{
    private const PER_PAGE = 25;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly SuperAdminEventRepositoryInterface $events,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Paginate all events across all workspaces for the Super Admin events index.
     *
     * TeamScope is automatically bypassed when the authenticated user is a
     * SYSTEM_ADMIN (JetstreamTenantContext::shouldBypassTenantScope()), so no
     * explicit withoutTeamScope() call is needed here.
     *
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, Event>
     */
    public function paginateEvents(
        string $search,
        string $state,
        ?int $teamId = null,
        int $perPage = self::PER_PAGE,
    ): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $this->events->paginateEvents($search, $state, $teamId, $perPage);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>  value => translated label
     */
    public function stateOptions(): array
    {
        $options = [];
        foreach (EventState::cases() as $case) {
            $options[$case->value] = __('events.state.'.$case->value);
        }

        return $options;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: int, name: string}>
     */
    public function workspaceSuggestions(string $search): array
    {
        return $this->events->workspaceSuggestions($search);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Services;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Platform-support export of a single event's registration list.
 *
 * Separate from the tenant-facing EventExportService: platform support staff
 * must be able to pull the list while investigating a delivery complaint
 * regardless of the workspace's plan entitlements, and the row shape carries
 * the registrant email that the delivery investigation needs.
 *
 * TeamScope is bypassed at the scope layer for SYSTEM_ADMIN actors
 * (User::shouldBypassTeamScope), so no explicit scope bypass belongs here.
 */
class SuperAdminRegistrationExportService
{
    public function response(Event $event): StreamedResponse
    {
        $rows = $this->rows($event);

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($rows): void {
            $handle = fopen('php://output', 'wb');
            if ($handle === false) {
                return;
            }

            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                fputcsv($handle, $row, escape: '\\');
            }

            fclose($handle);
        }, $this->filename($event), [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function rows(Event $event): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers()];

        /** @var Collection<int, Registration> $registrations */
        $registrations = Registration::query()
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get();

        foreach ($registrations as $index => $registration) {
            $rows[] = [
                (string) ($index + 1),
                (string) $registration->full_name,
                (string) $registration->email,
                (string) ($registration->company ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->title ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->country ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->industry ?? ''),
                (string) $registration->source,
                $registration->attended_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',
                $registration->created_at->toIso8601String(),
            ];
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function headers(): array
    {
        $headers = __('events.exports.headers.platform_registrations');

        return is_array($headers) ? array_values(array_map('strval', $headers)) : [];
    }

    private function filename(Event $event): string
    {
        $slug = str((string) $event->title)->slug('-')->toString();
        $stem = $slug !== '' ? $slug : 'event';

        return sprintf('%s-%s-registrations.csv', $stem, $event->uuid);
    }
}

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Services\SuperAdminRegistrationExportService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Streams a single event's registration list as CSV for platform support.
 *
 * The capability is asserted here as well as in config/route_permissions.php:
 * the rows carry attendee personal data, so access must be the explicit global
 * event-visibility capability rather than whatever the admin area allows.
 */
class EventRegistrationExportController
{
    private const CAPABILITY = 'events.view.global';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly SuperAdminRegistrationExportService $exports,
    ) {}

    public function __invoke(Request $request, Event $event): StreamedResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        abort_if(! $actor instanceof User, 403);
        abort_if(Gate::forUser($actor)->denies(self::CAPABILITY), 403);

        return $this->exports->response($event);
    }
}

**Verification**

```
./.atdd-verify tests/Feature/SuperAdmin/AdminEventRegistrationExportTest.php
OK (3 tests, 132 assertions)
```

RED run before implementation failed for the right reason: `Route [admin.events.registrations.export] not defined` plus the missing config entry — no syntax/import/harness errors. The AC3 test also confirmed at RED time that the capability-stripped actor still renders `admin.dashboard`, so the refusal it asserts is genuinely about the export capability, not admin-area access.

**Commits**
- `b39b19ec test: RED for T4` — `tests/Feature/SuperAdmin/AdminEventRegistrationExportTest.php`
- `43b9bb6e feat: implement T4`
  - `app/Modules/SuperAdmin/Routes/web.php` — named GET `admin.events.registrations.export` at `admin/events/{event:uuid}/registrations/export`
  - `app/Modules/SuperAdmin/Http/Controllers/EventRegistrationExportController.php` — thin; asserts `events.view.global` via `Gate::forUser()`
  - `app/Modules/SuperAdmin/Services/SuperAdminRegistrationExportService.php` — event-scoped rows, streamed CSV download
  - `config/route_permissions.php` — one added entry mapped to `events.view.global`
  - `lang/en/events.php`, `lang/tr/events.php` — CSV header row for the new export

**Design decisions worth flagging**
- Gated on `events.view.global`, not `system_admin_access`: the endpoint checks the same capability the config declares, so an admin-area user who lacks global event visibility gets 403 with no CSV body.
- Deliberately did **not** reuse `EventExportService`: it applies the tenant's `EXPORTS` plan entitlement gate, which would block platform support depending on the customer's plan, and its registrant row shape omits the email a delivery-complaint investigation needs.
- Filename is `<title-slug>-<event-uuid>-registrations.csv` — uuid makes it unambiguous when titles collide.

**Unresolved risk**
- The export includes registrant email (personal data) with no audit-log row. The existing SuperAdmin module rule only mandates audit for destructive actions, so I did not add one, but a PII read of this kind is a plausible candidate for audit logging in a follow-up.
- AC6 is enforced by a frozen inline snapshot of the 57 pre-existing `admin.*` permission entries. Legitimate future changes to any of those routes will require updating that snapshot.
- Verification was scoped to the capsule test plus the two route-capability architecture guards (`RouteCapabilityRouteMappingTest`, `RouteCapabilityPermissionStringTest`, 5/5 green); no broad suite was run.

  - `app/Modules/SuperAdmin/Services/SuperAdminRegistrationExportService.php` — event-scoped rows, streamed CSV download
  - `config/route_permissions.php` — one added entry mapped to `events.view.global`
  - `lang/en/events.php`, `lang/tr/events.php` — CSV header row for the new export

**Design decisions worth flagging**
- Gated on `events.view.global`, not `system_admin_access`: the endpoint checks the same capability the config declares, so an admin-area user who lacks global event visibility gets 403 with no CSV body.
- Deliberately did **not** reuse `EventExportService`: it applies the tenant's `EXPORTS` plan entitlement gate, which would block platform support depending on the customer's plan, and its registrant row shape omits the email a delivery-complaint investigation needs.
- Filename is `<title-slug>-<event-uuid>-registrations.csv` — uuid makes it unambiguous when titles collide.

**Unresolved risk**
- The export includes registrant email (personal data) with no audit-log row. The existing SuperAdmin module rule only mandates audit for destructive actions, so I did not add one, but a PII read of this kind is a plausible candidate for audit logging in a follow-up.
- AC6 is enforced by a frozen inline snapshot of the 57 pre-existing `admin.*` permission entries. Legitimate future changes to any of those routes will require updating that snapshot.
- Verification was scoped to the capsule test plus the two route-capability architecture guards (`RouteCapabilityRouteMappingTest`, `RouteCapabilityPermissionStringTest`, 5/5 green); no broad suite was run.
